explanation:
$\begin{aligned} & P=\sqrt{P^2+3 P^2+2 \cdot P \cdot \sqrt{3} P \cos \alpha} \\ & \Rightarrow P^2=4 P^2+2 \sqrt{3} P^2 \cos \alpha \Rightarrow 2 \sqrt{3} P^2 \cos \alpha=-3 P^2\end{aligned}$

$\Rightarrow \cos \alpha=-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=\cos 150^{\circ} \quad \therefore \alpha=150^{\circ}$
